conceptual assets.information: Payload words written through the CSR interface are queued for transmission to the ICC peer, and delivery depends on the FIFO and its acknowledgment flow. The FIFO is a buffering path, so the payload crosses through csr_wdata_i and icc_tx_o.dat without an independently held RTL signal.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: An integrator may treat transmitted payloads as secret, and the FIFO carries them to the externally observable icc_tx_o.dat at line 86. The FIFO accepts csr_wdata_i at line 81, so changing a queued word changes the transmitted payload. Withholding icc_rx_i.ack at line 85 can prevent the FIFO from advancing and keep the payload from leaving through icc_tx_o.dat.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could inject or alter CSR-written payloads and withhold transmission acknowledgments to corrupt or stall the ICC transfer.

conceptual assets.information: A payload word presented by the ICC peer on icc_rx_i.dat is returned to software through the CSR readback path when the receive-ready indication is asserted. The unit does not store the word independently; it directly transfers it to csr_rdata_o.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Received payload may contain secret information and is exposed at csr_rdata_o by the assignment at line 52. The rdy condition at line 51 can withhold the received word, so an attacker controlling the receive-valid condition can block its required readback.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could expose the received payload through the CSR readback or suppress the receive-ready condition so software cannot obtain it.

conceptual assets.information: The CSR address and receive-valid decision select whether the readback path returns zero, receive status, transmit-space status, or received payload data. Correct selection is required for software to observe the intended ICC register value.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The address and receive-valid selection controls which value reaches csr_rdata_o at lines 46-53, so altering the decision can return an incorrect value. An unmatched address or a false receive-ready decision can withhold the required readback through the default and conditional logic at lines 45-53.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could steer the CSR readback selection to return status or zero instead of the requested received data, or prevent a valid read from completing.

considered, not kept.reason: Clock and reset are excluded conceptual assets; they only wire to the FIFO at lines 75-76 and are covered by the clock/reset rule.
FIFO depth, width, synchronization, safety, and reset behavior are fixed by build-time generics at lines 67-71 and cannot be changed or withheld at run time.
